title: Authoritarianism of Code
summary: A philosophical reflection on how code is inherently authoritarian - it enforces rules exactly as written without interpretation or flexibility, exploring the implications of this strict nature in software development and its relationship to human communication and power structures.
problem_solved: Explores the fundamental nature of code as an authoritarian force that demands strict adherence to rules.
why_valuable: Offers deep philosophical insight into why code differs from natural language and what this means for developers and the software industry.
